summary: Nora can keep a picture from a web page she looked at and show it in a document. Opening a page now lists the page's picture links, looking at one with the media tool keeps it, and its code goes in the document's Image block.
details: Only a picture she chose to look at is kept, in the room where she looked. Clips, story frames and the automatic readings of Instagram posts keep nothing.
She is told to credit the page under Sources.
limitations: Only png, jpeg, gif and webp pictures are kept; an SVG or AVIF is looked at but not kept.
A picture already held from another room gets no code, so it cannot be put in a document here.
A kept picture is findable and sendable only in the room where she looked at it.
There is no image search: pictures come from pages somebody collected, and nothing yet limits how many a room keeps.
